opening.argument: The material is presented as a recurring roundup of trending stories, combining film coverage, reported alcohol-related shopping behavior, and a restaurant promotion. The Chipotle segment describes free guacamole only when viewers buy a meal online or through the app using a code, which is an ordinary commerce promotion rather than an unsupported promise of money or goods. The sampled screen likewise shows a conventional avocado product listing priced at $4.00 with quantity controls and an add-to-cart button. At most, the material reports the promotion and related survey figures; it does not establish that the offer is currently available or independently verify those figures. Those limitations counsel against treating the segment as deceptive solicitation.
